name: ♡Happy pink pills♡
source:
Many pills for a very big sadness. A larger girl crosses a long path of nostalgia and discouragement. There are different routes that give you different results, from a strange dream with the supermarket boy or a psychopath doctor.

[From [url=https://chumii-chan.itch.io/happy-pink-pills]Itch.io[/url]]
